RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Molten Brand
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Mark an enemy for 8 seconds. Store 20% of your actual damage, up to 36. Explodes on expiry or death.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Detonate
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Consume your chosen brand. Autocast waits for 24 stored damage or 2 seconds remaining.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Rally Legion
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: All ordinary projections defend the point and attack enemies within 6 cells of it. Choose your own cell to resume guard duty. Manual only.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Focus Legion
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: All ordinary projections pursue this enemy. Resume guard duty if the target becomes invalid or moves over 30 cells from the owner. Manual only.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Frontline Exchange
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Swap with your ordinary projection. Gain 12 shield; the projection takes 25% less damage, both for 3 seconds. Manual only.
